headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang takes Trump's call onstage, calls AI fears a 'hoax'
summary: Former President Trump joined Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang via speakerphone at the All-In Summit, dismissing AI fears as a "hoax" and stating "the robots will not be taking over."
details: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang took a call from former President Trump during his appearance at the All-In Podcast's All-In Summit. Huang placed Trump on speakerphone for the audience to hear.

During the call, Trump addressed concerns about AI development, calling them a "hoax" and asserting that "the robots will not be taking over." This comes as other tech leaders, like Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, have called for pacing AI development.

Trump also commented on the economic impact of data centers, suggesting they bring wealth to communities. Huang, in response, assured Trump that Nvidia is committed to ensuring everyone wins in the AI race.
Huang emphasized the broad reach of his message, noting he was speaking to thousands of people. The conversation highlights ongoing debates about AI's future and its societal implications.
